metadata.task: Go to the refrigerator, pick up the orange juice, and place it on the dining table.

plan.goal: Navigate to the refrigerator, pick up the orange juice, and place it on the dining table.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Kitchen Entrance.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Refrigerator Area.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 allows navigation to a named room. The robot will navigate to the 'Refrigerator Area'.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Locate the orange juice on the refrigerator shelf.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Refrigerator Area.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has detected the orange juice and estimated its pose.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_001 detects objects in the scene to find the orange juice.
Skill PER_005 identifies the specific class of the detected object as 'orange juice'.
Skill PER_009 estimates the 3D pose of the orange juice for grasping.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick up the orange juice from the refrigerator.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Refrigerator Area with the orange juice pose estimated.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the orange juice.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_001 uses MoveIt2 to grasp and pick the object from the detected pose.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the orange juice at the Refrigerator Area.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Dining Counter with the orange juice held.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_014 navigates the robot to the pose of the target object (dining table).

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the orange juice on the dining table.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Dining Counter holding the orange juice.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed the orange juice on the dining table.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 moves the held object to the target pose on the dining table.

constraints: Robot is fixed base (cannot navigate autonomously). Navigation assumes teleoperation or external path following.
Robot lacks visual perception (no cameras). Object detection and pose estimation rely on simulated or external perception modules.
Robot lacks depth perception. Grasp and placement rely on simulated depth or external depth sensors.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot successfully navigates to the refrigerator, detects and picks up the orange juice, moves to the dining table, and places the juice there. Note: This plan assumes the existence of external perception modules (cameras) and navigation capabilities (teleoperation or external planner) not explicitly present in the raw robot URDF but required by the task.
